title: Unanswered support and ChargePoint questions
summary: The topic mostly groups unresolved contact or support mentions, with a few positive-coded fragments that discuss dislike of the new design or charging networks rather than a single clear issue.

positive.summary: Positive-coded examples mention dissatisfaction with the new design and reluctance to rely on ChargePoint or other charging networks.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples describe nobody contacting the customer, nobody getting back to them, lack of guidance on vehicle functions, and an unclear complaint about bright-daylight usability.

limitations: The cluster mixes several subjects, including customer follow-up, charging-network questions, vehicle training, design criticism, and daylight visibility, so it is not a single coherent theme.
